parameters.seed_rule: seed = seed_base + 10000*regime_index + i, i in range(seeds)
parameters.unit: synthetic signed error in the paper's F0-scaled unit, F0 = 1
parameters.support_rule: pair is PAIRS[seed % 15]; triple is TRIPLES[seed % 20]; channels are uniform over the non-baseline rows

p1_absolute_manufactures.statement: the absolute-value cell-maximum statistic reports material interactions on a signed-additive surface
p1_absolute_manufactures.criterion: per regime: supported if the primary-margin absolute rate is at least 0.5, partial if any margin is positive, refuted if every rate is zero; overall takes the strongest regime

p2_signed_abstains.statement: the signed pointwise statistic abstains on a signed-additive surface
p2_signed_abstains.criterion: supported if the signed rate is zero at every margin in every regime

p3_design_35_covers_pair_not_triple.statement: the 35-cell design covers a one-pairwise surface but not a three-factor one
p3_design_35_covers_pair_not_triple.criterion: at the largest magnitude and the signed fit: supported if the pair violation rate is zero in every regime and the triple rate is positive in at least one regime; refuted if the triple rate is zero in every regime; mixed otherwise

threshold_a_additive_abs_at_primary.statement: zero false material absolute-value interactions at the primary margin on the known-additive surfaces

threshold_b_d35_coverage.statement: zero held-out violations of the 35-cell design with its measured allowance, and every margin at least one, on every synthetic surface
